zh.name: 杂志风 · 金句解读
zh.summary: 用大字突出一句原文，再展开出处、含义和应用，让好句子有理解、有启发。
zh.useWhen: 阅读笔记、访谈金句、演讲和文章精读。
zh.instructions: 提供逐字原句、出处、相关背景和希望展开的应用方向。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Editorial Quote Reading
en.summary: Lead with a sourced quote, develop its meaning, then demonstrate a small practical use.
en.useWhen: Book notes, interviews, talks, and close reading.
en.instructions: Provide the exact quote, source, context, and what you wish to apply.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
